draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in its training annotations: its mean test F1 drops by at most 2.0 points at every tested noise rate (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points at 10%, 20% and 30% noise, respectively) on the Corvane-News NER test set.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops of 0.6, 1.3, 1.8 points at 10/20/30% noise, all within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion. The sentence's hedge "appears somewhat" understates this; the evidence supports an unqualified robustness claim within the evaluated scope.
